title: Website Policies
text:
Extracts of the information in the website may be reviewed, reproduced or translated **and associated portals may be reviewed, reproduced or translated** for research or private study but not for sale or for use in conjunction with commercial purposes. Any use of information in the website **or associated portals** should be accompanied by an acknowledgement of the UIDAI as the source, citing the uniform resource locator (URL) of the article/page.
